title: Plan and Budget: Effective and Efficient Test-Time Scaling on Large Language Model Reasoning
authors_zh: Junhong Lin、Xinyue Zeng 等（MIT CSAIL、Virginia Tech、弗吉尼亚大学、密歇根州立大学）
paper_type_zh: 自适应 token 预算分配与测试时扩展论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 设计推理计划、token 预算或审计过度思考的读者。
one_line: Plan-and-Budget decomposes a query and adaptively assigns token budgets to subquestions instead of using a fixed thinking length.
Plan-and-Budget 按子问题复杂度分配 token 预算，以避免简单问题过度思考、困难问题思考不足。
why: It makes token allocation an observable decision rather than treating longer reasoning as a free improvement.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly allocates finite token budgets across reasoning subproblems and evaluates the correctness-efficiency trade-off.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Longer reasoning can help difficult questions, but a fixed thinking budget wastes tokens on easy ones and can encourage overthinking. A system also needs to decide where effort belongs after a question has been decomposed into subproblems.

The paper asks how planning and token allocation can be made explicit test-time decisions. Its aim is to increase correctness under a finite budget while reducing unnecessary reasoning, rather than treating every question and every intermediate step as equally expensive.

更长的推理能够帮助困难问题，但固定的思考预算会在简单问题上浪费 token，也可能鼓励过度思考。系统还需要在问题被分解为子问题后决定应把精力放在哪里。

本文研究如何把规划和 token 分配变成明确的测试时决策。目标是在有限预算下提高正确性并减少不必要的推理，而不是把每个问题和每个中间步骤都视为同样昂贵。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Plan-and-Budget separates deciding what to solve from deciding how long to think about it. It creates a plan, estimates the difficulty or uncertainty of the resulting subquestions, and assigns a nonuniform reasoning budget instead of extending every trajectory by the same amount.

The framework is valuable only if its planning overhead is repaid by better allocation. The paper therefore frames efficiency as a joint correctness–token question: spending less is not a gain if the allocation merely moves error from easy questions to hard ones.

规划与预算方法把决定解决什么和决定为其思考多久分开。它创建计划，估计由此得到的子问题的难度或不确定性，并分配不均匀的推理预算，而不是把每条轨迹以相同幅度延长。

该框架只有在规划开销由更好的分配回收时才有价值。因此，论文把效率表述为正确性与 token 的联合问题：如果分配只是把错误从简单问题转移到困难问题，花得更少并不是收益。

title: Method
方法
html:
For an input, the system proposes a decomposition and uses a budget-allocation model to assign reasoning tokens across subquestions. It then executes the scheduled reasoning process and combines the partial work into a final answer, with the allocation depending on estimated complexity rather than a fixed length.

The evaluation uses token-aware comparisons and the paper’s correctness–efficiency measure. To reproduce it, preserve the plan, subquestion list, estimates, token assignments, actual generated tokens, and final outcome; a nominal maximum length alone cannot reveal whether a method saved computation or merely truncated attempts.

对于一个输入，系统提出分解，并使用预算分配模型在子问题之间分配推理 token。随后，它执行已安排的推理过程并把部分工作合成为最终答案，其中分配依赖估计的复杂度，而非固定长度。

评估使用 token 感知的比较和论文的正确性—效率度量。复现时应保留计划、子问题列表、估计、token 分配、实际生成 token 和最终结果；仅有名义上的最大长度无法说明方法是节省了计算还是只是截断了尝试。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports higher accuracy with fewer reasoning tokens than compared baselines and uses its E3 measure to summarize the correctness–efficiency trade-off. Reported comparisons include large reasoning models, supporting the claim that adaptive allocation can improve the operating point rather than only increase the ceiling.

Those results depend on the decomposition quality and the cost model used for planning and decoding. A credible reading compares all token use, including planning, and checks whether the same savings remain on unseen task types where the model’s complexity estimate may be unreliable.

论文报告，相比所比较的基线，该方法用更少的推理 token 获得更高准确率，并使用其 E3 度量概括正确性—效率权衡。报告的比较包括大型推理模型，支持自适应分配能够改善运行点而不仅是提高上限的主张。

这些结果依赖分解质量和用于规划与解码的成本模型。可信的阅读应比较全部 token 使用，包括规划，并检查在模型复杂度估计可能不可靠的未见任务类型上，是否仍保留同样的节省。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is not decomposition by itself; reasoning systems already plan. The paper makes per-subquestion budget allocation the object of optimization and evaluates it against both accuracy and consumption, so “think longer” becomes a controllable decision rather than a global default.

This differs from a pure prompting trick because the method records a schedule that can be audited. It also differs from best-of-N selection: it allocates a sequential token budget inside a planned solution rather than choosing among a fixed set of completed candidates.

新意不在于分解本身；推理系统已经会规划。论文把逐子问题的预算分配变成优化对象，并同时相对于准确率和消耗进行评估，因此“思考更久”成为可控制的决策，而不是全局默认值。

这不同于纯提示技巧，因为方法记录了可审计的时间表。它也不同于最佳候选选择：它是在计划解内部顺序分配 token 预算，而不是从一组固定的完整候选中选择。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Complexity estimates can be wrong, planning can add latency and tokens, and an early decomposition can lock the system into an unhelpful route. The efficiency metric depends on what costs are counted and may not reflect wall-clock serving constraints, tool calls, or parallel execution. A model can also appear efficient by shortening explanations while preserving only benchmarks with short final answers. Reuse should publish the full cost ledger and inspect failures where the system underallocates effort to an initially misclassified hard subproblem.
复杂度估计可能出错，规划会增加时延和 token，而早期分解可能把系统锁定在无益路径上。效率度量取决于计入哪些成本，可能无法反映真实服务约束、工具调用或并行执行。模型还可能通过缩短解释而显得高效，同时只保留最终答案很短的基准。复用时应发布完整成本账本，并检查系统对最初被误分类为简单的难子问题投入不足的失败案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a reasoning product has a strict token or latency envelope and can expose a plan before solving. Compare fixed-length reasoning, adaptive allocation without planning, and the full method under the same end-to-end budget. Log the proposed plan and actual spend for each input so a reader can tell whether gains come from correct difficulty estimation or a hidden change in the answer-generation policy. It is less useful for tasks that cannot be decomposed meaningfully or require a single irreducible search process.
当推理产品具有严格的 token 或时延范围，并能在求解前暴露计划时，可以使用本文。应在相同端到端预算下比较固定长度推理、无规划的自适应分配和完整方法。为每个输入记录提出的计划和实际开销，使读者能够判断收益来自正确的难度估计，还是来自答案生成策略的隐藏变化。对于无法有意义分解或需要单一不可约搜索过程的任务，它不太有用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper through its allocation trace. Ask whether the plan really changes the budget, whether hard subquestions receive more tokens, and whether planning cost is counted before declaring an efficiency gain. The strongest ablation removes the allocation model while preserving the same decomposition and maximum token allowance. Also inspect the tail: an average token reduction can coexist with a small number of inputs that are much slower, which matters for interactive systems.
应通过其分配轨迹阅读本文。要问计划是否真正改变预算、困难子问题是否获得更多 token，以及在宣布效率收益前是否计入规划成本。最强的消融是在保留相同分解和最大 token 上限的同时移除分配模型。还要检查尾部：平均 token 降低可以与少量输入明显更慢同时存在，这对交互系统很重要。
